qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/run_golden.sh, tests/persist.cjs, tests/lib.cjs (launch/openPage), results/persist-before.json, results/persist-after.json, results/restart.json, results/runtime.json (index-named artifacts; sha256 of run_golden.sh, persist.cjs, persist-before.json, persist-after.json and restart.json recomputed and equal to the index)
evidence: Defining behaviour is graded. Editing on the custom surface: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:24-30 (cw_custom_typing_and_line_join) plus the multi-caret, find/replace and format criteria; Run beside the source: judge.toml:213-219 (cw_basic_run_output: typed program, computed sum in preview and console, changed and re-run) and :222-228 (cw_html_preview); keeping versions without losing a draft: :348-363 (stale save refused, dirty draft kept) and :366-372 (history restore). Durability is proven in three steps that match the public requirement (environment/instructions/behaviour.md:9 'A fresh page must read the saved record from the running app, and saved work and history must survive a complete server restart'; integration.md:7 survive reloads and complete process restarts, shared between independent browser contexts). (1) Gate tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:27-34 cw_shared_saved_record: save through the UI, then clear this origin's browser storage and reload, re-open and compare exact title, filename and source, reload again. app_context.md:26 defines the clearing as localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, OPFS, service worker registrations and cookies, so a browser-only store cannot survive; this is real server-backed evidence, not a same-origin or health-response inference. (2) functional judge.toml:339-345 cw_save_reload_restart repeats the storage-clear readback and then calls restart_app once; revision, title, filename, source and history must be identical on a fresh page, 'Do not infer a restart from a reload or a health response'. The tool is real: tests/test.sh:127-184 writes a helper that kills the process group and relaunches node on the same DB_PATH, tools/restart_mcp.py:25-47 runs it single-use and reports isError on failure; functional/prompt.md:29-31 forbids claiming a restart the tool did not report. (3) Cross-tab sharing is exercised by judge.toml:375-381 and :348-354 (third page fresh read). Weak apps: IndexedDB/localStorage-only library fails the gate (reward 0); in-memory server Map passes the gate but fails cw_save_reload_restart; a no-op Save fails the gate. Conforming alternatives: any route names, any schema, canvas editor, a Save response that does not echo fields ('the response need not echo the saved fields') all still pass; records are identified by unique title chosen by the judge, no empty-library assumption (app_context.md:24). Scripted golden on these bytes: results/persist-before.json reports cw_shared_saved_record true and cw_save_reload_restart(before) true; run_golden.sh:36 replaces the node process with pkill and restart; results/persist-after.json reports cw_save_reload_restart true read from a newly launched browser (persist.cjs:11,32-44), restart.json shows revision 2 and history [2,1]; runtime.json reports cw_basic_run_output and cw_html_preview true. Residual, not a defect of this row: SQLite itself is not browser-provable (a JSON file store would also pass), which REVIEW_POLICY accepts ('A browser exchange cannot prove SQLite'); a store held in a different browser origin or a remote public service would survive the origin-scoped clearing and the restart inside the single --isolated judge browser, but that is an implausible deliberate evasion and no criterion can exclude it without a second browser profile. risk=true only because no configured-judge run exists for these exact bytes (index scope statement); the hosted Oracle run was on an earlier candidate and the golden script is not the LLM judge or tests/test.sh in the verifier image.
